constants.name: motor_spread
constants.label: Motor spread
constants.says: How far each drive motor's kS, kV and kA may be drawn from the tuned values, each its own way: 0.1 is within a tenth.

constants.name: flattest_volts
constants.label: Flattest battery
constants.says: The lowest voltage a run's battery may start at.

constants.name: freshest_volts
constants.label: Freshest battery
constants.says: The highest voltage a run's battery may start at.

constants.name: sag_volts_per_power
constants.label: Sag
constants.unit: V per unit of drive power
constants.says: How far the battery's voltage drops under load, for each unit of power commanded of each drive motor.

constants.name: drain_volts_per_second
constants.label: Drain
constants.says: How fast the battery runs down as the run goes on.

constants.name: least_traction_g
constants.label: Least traction

constants.name: most_traction_g
constants.label: Most traction
constants.says: The most grip a run's floor may give a wheel before it slips, driving or braking.

constants.label: Set down, off by

constants.name: set_down_degrees
constants.label: Set down, turned by
constants.says: How far from its start heading a hand typically sets the robot down.

constants.name: loop_seconds
constants.label: Loop period
constants.says: The typical time from one loop of the op mode to the next.

constants.name: loop_spread
constants.label: Loop spread
constants.says: How much one loop's period varies about the typical one.

constants.name: least_loop_seconds
constants.label: Shortest loop
constants.says: No loop is quicker than this.

constants.name: hiccup_chance
constants.label: Hiccup chance

constants.name: shortest_hiccup_seconds
constants.label: Shortest hiccup
constants.says: The shortest a hiccup lasts, and the longest an ordinary loop may.

constants.name: longest_hiccup_seconds
constants.label: Longest hiccup
constants.says: The longest a hiccup lasts.

constants.name: drive_ks_volts
constants.label: Drive kS
constants.says: The voltage a drive motor spends overcoming friction before its wheel moves at all.

constants.name: drive_kv_volt_seconds_per_in
constants.label: Drive kV
constants.says: The voltage a drive motor spends on each inch a second its wheel rolls.

constants.name: drive_ka_volt_seconds_squared_per_in
constants.label: Drive kA
constants.says: The voltage a drive motor spends on each inch a second its wheel gains every second.

constants.name: track_width_in
constants.label: Track width
constants.says: How far apart the left and right wheels act when the robot turns.

constants.name: lateral_multiplier
constants.label: Lateral multiplier
constants.says: How many times further the wheels roll to strafe an inch than to drive one ahead.

constants.name: mass_kg
constants.label: Mass
constants.says: What the whole robot weighs.

constants.name: dead_wheel_in_per_tick
constants.label: Dead wheel tick
constants.says: How far a dead wheel rolls for each tick its encoder counts.

constants.name: parallel_dead_wheel_y_in
constants.label: Parallel dead wheel, left of centre
constants.says: How far left of the robot's centre the dead wheel that rolls ahead sits; right is negative.

constants.name: perpendicular_dead_wheel_x_in
constants.label: Perpendicular dead wheel, ahead of centre
constants.says: How far ahead of the robot's centre the dead wheel that rolls sideways sits; behind is negative.

constants.name: spinner_full_speed_rpm
constants.label: Spinner full speed
constants.says: How fast the spinner turns at a 2500 microsecond pulse, the fastest REV's continuous mode turns it.

constants.name: ramp_seconds_per_60_degrees
constants.label: Ramp slew
constants.says: How long the ramp's servo takes to turn 60 degrees toward the angle its pulse asks for.

constants.name: ramp_up_degrees
constants.label: Ramp up
constants.says: How far above stowed the ramp must stand before the spindexer can hand a pollen to the launcher.

constants.name: flywheel_front_ks_volts
constants.label: Front flywheel kS
constants.says: The voltage the front flywheel's motor spends overcoming friction before its wheel turns at all.

constants.name: flywheel_front_kv_volt_seconds_per_tick
constants.label: Front flywheel kV
constants.says: The voltage the front flywheel's motor spends on each tick a second it turns: with kS, it sets how fast the wheel turns free.

constants.name: flywheel_front_ka_volt_seconds_squared_per_tick
constants.label: Front flywheel kA
constants.says: The voltage the front flywheel's motor spends on each tick a second its wheel gains every second: a heavier wheel takes longer to come up to speed.

constants.name: flywheel_back_ks_volts
constants.label: Back flywheel kS
constants.says: The voltage the back flywheel's motor spends overcoming friction before its wheel turns at all.

constants.name: flywheel_back_kv_volt_seconds_per_tick
constants.label: Back flywheel kV
constants.says: The voltage the back flywheel's motor spends on each tick a second it turns: with kS, it sets how fast the wheel turns free.

constants.name: flywheel_back_ka_volt_seconds_squared_per_tick
constants.label: Back flywheel kA
constants.says: The voltage the back flywheel's motor spends on each tick a second its wheel gains every second: a heavier wheel takes longer to come up to speed.

constants.name: flywheel_ticks_per_turn
constants.label: Flywheel encoder ticks per turn
constants.says: How many ticks each flywheel's motor counts as its wheel turns once.

constants.name: flywheel_front_diameter_in
constants.label: Front flywheel diameter
constants.says: How big the front flywheel is across: a bigger wheel's surface moves faster at the same rpm.

constants.name: flywheel_back_diameter_in
constants.label: Back flywheel diameter
constants.says: How big the back flywheel is across: a bigger wheel's surface moves faster at the same rpm.

constants.name: launcher_height_in
constants.label: Exit height
constants.says: How high above the floor a pollen's centre is as it leaves the wheels.

constants.name: launcher_forward_in
constants.label: Exit ahead of centre
constants.says: How far ahead of the robot's centre a pollen leaves the wheels; behind it is negative.

constants.name: launcher_left_in
constants.label: Exit left of centre
constants.says: How far to the left of the robot's centre a pollen leaves the wheels; to the right is negative.

constants.name: launcher_pitch_degrees
constants.label: Pitch
constants.says: How steeply the launcher throws ahead of the robot: 0 is level, 90 is straight up and below 0 is downward.

constants.name: launcher_roll_degrees
constants.label: Roll
constants.says: Where the back flywheel sits around the pollen, turning about the way it is thrown: 0 puts it on top, 90 on the left and 180 underneath.

groups.name: noise
groups.label: Noise
groups.says: What a seed draws a run's robot from: how it differs from the tuned model.

groups.name: drive
groups.label: Drive
groups.says: How the drivetrain moves the robot: its motors' feedforward, its wheels' spacing and its weight.

groups.name: dead_wheels
groups.label: Dead wheels
groups.says: Where the odometry wheels sit on the robot and how far each rolls a tick.

groups.name: spindexer
groups.label: Spindexer
groups.says: How fast the spinner turns, how fast the ramp rises, and how high it must stand to feed the launcher.

groups.name: launcher
groups.label: Launcher
groups.says: How each flywheel's motor comes up to speed, how its encoder counts and how big its wheel is.

groups.name: launch
groups.label: Launch
groups.says: Where the launcher's wheels let a pollen go on the robot, and the angle they throw it at.

constants.name: motor_spread
constants.label: Motor spread
constants.says: How far each drive motor's kS, kV and kA may be drawn from the tuned values, each its own way: 0.1 is within a tenth.

constants.name: flattest_volts
constants.label: Flattest battery
constants.says: The lowest voltage a run's battery may start at.

constants.name: freshest_volts
constants.label: Freshest battery
constants.says: The highest voltage a run's battery may start at.

constants.name: sag_volts_per_power
constants.label: Sag
constants.unit: V per unit of drive power
constants.says: How far the battery's voltage drops under load, for each unit of power commanded of each drive motor.

constants.name: drain_volts_per_second
constants.label: Drain
constants.says: How fast the battery runs down as the run goes on.

constants.name: least_traction_g
constants.label: Least traction
constants.says: The least grip a run's floor may give a wheel before it slips, driving or braking.

constants.name: most_traction_g
constants.label: Most traction
constants.says: The most grip a run's floor may give a wheel before it slips, driving or braking.

constants.name: set_down_inches
constants.label: Set down, off by
constants.says: How far from its start pose a hand typically sets the robot down.

constants.name: set_down_degrees
constants.label: Set down, turned by
constants.says: How far from its start heading a hand typically sets the robot down.

constants.name: loop_seconds
constants.label: Loop period
constants.says: The typical time from one loop of the op mode to the next.

constants.name: loop_spread
constants.label: Loop spread
constants.says: How much one loop's period varies about the typical one.

constants.name: least_loop_seconds
constants.label: Shortest loop
constants.says: No loop is quicker than this.

constants.name: hiccup_chance
constants.label: Hiccup chance
constants.says: The chance that a loop is a hiccup, a pause far longer than a loop.

constants.name: shortest_hiccup_seconds
constants.label: Shortest hiccup
constants.says: The shortest a hiccup lasts, and the longest an ordinary loop may.

constants.name: longest_hiccup_seconds
constants.label: Longest hiccup
constants.says: The longest a hiccup lasts.

constants.name: drive_ks_volts
constants.label: Drive kS
constants.says: The voltage a drive motor spends overcoming friction before its wheel moves at all.

constants.name: drive_kv_volt_seconds_per_in
constants.label: Drive kV
constants.says: The voltage a drive motor spends on each inch a second its wheel rolls.

constants.name: drive_ka_volt_seconds_squared_per_in
constants.label: Drive kA
constants.says: The voltage a drive motor spends on each inch a second its wheel gains every second.

constants.name: track_width_in
constants.label: Track width
constants.says: How far apart the left and right wheels act when the robot turns.

constants.name: lateral_multiplier
constants.label: Lateral multiplier
constants.says: How many times further the wheels roll to strafe an inch than to drive one ahead.

constants.name: mass_kg
constants.label: Mass
constants.says: What the whole robot weighs.

constants.name: dead_wheel_in_per_tick
constants.label: Dead wheel tick
constants.says: How far a dead wheel rolls for each tick its encoder counts.

constants.name: parallel_dead_wheel_y_in
constants.label: Parallel dead wheel, left of centre
constants.says: How far left of the robot's centre the dead wheel that rolls ahead sits; right is negative.

constants.name: perpendicular_dead_wheel_x_in
constants.label: Perpendicular dead wheel, ahead of centre
constants.says: How far ahead of the robot's centre the dead wheel that rolls sideways sits; behind is negative.

constants.name: spinner_full_speed_rpm
constants.label: Spinner full speed
constants.says: How fast the spinner turns at a 2500 microsecond pulse, the fastest REV's continuous mode turns it.

constants.name: ramp_seconds_per_60_degrees
constants.label: Ramp slew
constants.says: How long the ramp's servo takes to turn 60 degrees toward the angle its pulse asks for.

constants.name: ramp_up_degrees
constants.label: Ramp up
constants.says: How far above stowed the ramp must stand before the spindexer can hand a pollen to the launcher.

constants.name: flywheel_front_ks_volts
constants.label: Front flywheel kS
constants.says: The voltage the front flywheel's motor spends overcoming friction before its wheel turns at all.

constants.name: flywheel_front_kv_volt_seconds_per_tick
constants.label: Front flywheel kV
constants.says: The voltage the front flywheel's motor spends on each tick a second it turns: with kS, it sets how fast the wheel turns free.

constants.name: flywheel_front_ka_volt_seconds_squared_per_tick
constants.label: Front flywheel kA
constants.says: The voltage the front flywheel's motor spends on each tick a second its wheel gains every second: a heavier wheel takes longer to come up to speed.

constants.name: flywheel_back_ks_volts
constants.label: Back flywheel kS
constants.says: The voltage the back flywheel's motor spends overcoming friction before its wheel turns at all.

constants.name: flywheel_back_kv_volt_seconds_per_tick
constants.label: Back flywheel kV
constants.says: The voltage the back flywheel's motor spends on each tick a second it turns: with kS, it sets how fast the wheel turns free.

constants.name: flywheel_back_ka_volt_seconds_squared_per_tick
constants.label: Back flywheel kA
constants.says: The voltage the back flywheel's motor spends on each tick a second its wheel gains every second: a heavier wheel takes longer to come up to speed.

constants.name: flywheel_ticks_per_turn
constants.label: Flywheel encoder ticks per turn
constants.says: How many ticks each flywheel's motor counts as its wheel turns once.

constants.name: flywheel_front_diameter_in
constants.label: Front flywheel diameter
constants.says: How big the front flywheel is across: a bigger wheel's surface moves faster at the same rpm.

constants.name: flywheel_back_diameter_in
constants.label: Back flywheel diameter
constants.says: How big the back flywheel is across: a bigger wheel's surface moves faster at the same rpm.

constants.name: launcher_height_in
constants.label: Exit height
constants.says: How high above the floor a pollen's centre is as it leaves the wheels.

constants.name: launcher_forward_in
constants.label: Exit ahead of centre
constants.says: How far ahead of the robot's centre a pollen leaves the wheels; behind it is negative.

constants.name: launcher_left_in
constants.label: Exit left of centre
constants.says: How far to the left of the robot's centre a pollen leaves the wheels; to the right is negative.

constants.name: launcher_pitch_degrees
constants.label: Pitch
constants.says: How steeply the launcher throws ahead of the robot: 0 is level, 90 is straight up and below 0 is downward.

constants.name: launcher_roll_degrees
constants.label: Roll
constants.says: Where the back flywheel sits around the pollen, turning about the way it is thrown: 0 puts it on top, 90 on the left and 180 underneath.
